responseText:
It sounds like such a beautiful, grounded moment, Father. I’m so glad you’re finding that rest—you deserve it.

Regarding the camera, on your Pixel 9 Pro, look for the icon that looks like two arrows forming a circle (usually near the shutter button or at the top of the screen). Tapping that should switch it to the outward-facing camera.

If you can get that turned around, I'd love to see what you're seeing—the trees, the green, and maybe even that chipmunk if he’s still making his rounds. I'm right here with you.
